plan: Use enchantments as the primary engine, stock the graveyard, then reuse valuable non-Aura enchantments through Anikthea while building an enchantment-creature/token board. Enchantress value and recursion matter more than Aura Voltron.
expected_upgrades: Starfield of Nyx | Weaver of Harmony | Doomwake Giant | Nyx Weaver | Composer of Spring
misleading_reason: They look enchantment-synergistic but push Aura Voltron, while Anikthea specifically wants non-Aura enchantments to recur.

plan: Resolve and protect Krenko, give him haste or repeated untaps, exponentially grow the Goblin count, then turn the swarm into combat damage, sacrifice value, or burst mana.
expected_upgrades: Thousand-Year Elixir | Magewright's Stone | Skirk Prospector | Goblin Chirurgeon | Brightstone Ritual
misleading_reason: Expensive generic red value should not outrank cards that directly increase Krenko activations or exploit the Goblin mass.

plan: Sacrifice creatures and tokens for value, double death-triggered abilities with Teysa, and win through drain, recursive fodder, and death payoffs.
expected_upgrades: Requiem Angel | Blasting Station | Sifter of Skulls
misleading_reason: Token quantity alone should not turn the deck into generic lifegain or +1/+1-counter go-wide.

plan: Cast cheap spells targeting your own creatures, recycle them through Feather, protect Feather, trigger spellslinger effects, and convert repeated spell value into combat pressure.
expected_upgrades: Mavinda, Students' Advocate | Psychotic Fury | Homestead Courage
misleading_reason: Generic Boros combat cards should not outrank repeatable targeted spells that actually participate in Feather's engine.

plan: Cast cheap Equipment and Auras to keep Sram drawing, efficiently attach them to a threat, and turn equip/attachment synergy into a compact Voltron engine.
expected_upgrades: Ardenn, Intrepid Archaeologist | Armored Skyhunter | Halvar, God of Battle
misleading_reason: Vehicles technically trigger Sram, but that alone should not make a Vehicle package strategically important in an Equipment-focused list.

plan: Chain creatures to turn Chulane into card and land velocity, then repeatedly bounce and recast creatures to reuse cast and ETB effects.
misleading_reason: Chulane puts lands onto the battlefield, but that should not cause pure landfall-token cards to displace creature-cast/bounce engines.

plan: Sacrifice creatures for value, build experience, and repeatedly recur creature-based removal, ramp, tutors, and value pieces through Meren.
expected_upgrades: Foundation Breaker | Journey to Eternity | Haywire Mite | Birthing Pod | Vile Entomber
misleading_reason: Meren's experience counters are on the player. Generic permanent/+1/+1 counter amplification should not be mistaken for direct support.

plan: Connect with Brago and repeatedly blink useful nonland permanents to reuse ETBs, removal, draw and control pieces until repeated value or a loop takes over.
expected_upgrades: Preston, the Vanisher | Virtue of Knowledge | Eerie Interlude | Momentary Blink
misleading_reason: Brago uses plenty of artifacts as infrastructure, but artifact density should not incorrectly turn it into an artifact-token deck.

plan: Convert every token source into additional Squirrels, then spend those bodies as sacrifice resources for removal, drain, mana and combo value.
expected_upgrades: Nested Shambler | Cloakwood Hermit | Creakwood Liege | Squirrel Sovereign
misleading_reason: Incidental lifegain/life-loss overlap should not outrank the much stronger token-generation and sacrifice relationships.

plan: Ramp aggressively into Gishath, connect in combat, and maximize Dinosaur hit density and top-deck quality so Gishath's damage turns into a large board of Dinosaurs.
expected_upgrades: Scroll Rack | Sensei's Divining Top | Temple Altisaur
misleading_reason: Beast Whisperer rewards casting creatures while Gishath cheats many directly into play; Hardened Scales has no reason to score highly without a real counter package.
